name: Floating Disk
description:
You conjure a disk of force, which persists for 1 hour. Roll Lore. The result, divided by 5, in feet, is the maximum diameter of the disk, as well as the maximum height at which it can hover (you choose both). The disk can hold up to 25 times the result in pounds, disappearing instantly if more weight is placed on it.

If you move to be further than short range away from the disk, it moves toward you at a rate equal to your Speed until it is within short range of you again. If the disk falls down a sheer drop of 10 ft or more, it vanishes.

Describe the disk.
successes:
✨: The disk can hold an additional 100 lbs.

✨: The disk's maximum diameter or maximum hovering height increases by 2 ft.

🌞: The disk persists for 1 day.

💀: The disk is unreliable. Check a Condition. Each time a new creature becomes the closest creature to the disk, roll a d8. On a 1, the spell ends. Otherwise, the disk becomes tethered to that creature and follows it as described above.
